variables.v_in_max: Maximum supply voltage seen at VDD -- from the mission operating point (USB 5V, or a preceding regulator)
variables.v_bat_min: Battery voltage at the preconditioning-to-constant-current transition, the worst case
variables.i_charge: Fast-charge current, SET BY AN EXTERNAL RESISTOR on PROG -- a design choice, not a part property

design_notes.note: Worst-case dissipation occurs at maximum input voltage during the transition from preconditioning to constant-current mode -- not at steady state. Thermal checks must use this transition point, not the average charge condition.

Theta-JA is dominated by board copper area, not the package. The 230 C/W table figure is the minimum-copper case; a generous pour reaches 130 C/W. Any thermal claim must state which condition was assumed.

provenance.notes: Package body dimensions not yet extracted from the mechanical drawing -- deliberately absent rather than guessed. No conducted-emissions entry: this is a linear charger, so it has no switching node. Its dominant emission is heat.
